newsitem.title: USA: ORBITAL ENTERS $100 MLN CREDIT FACILITY.
newsitem.headline: ORBITAL ENTERS $100 MLN CREDIT FACILITY.

text.p: Orbital Sciences Corp said Monday that it has signed a four-year $100 million credit facility with six banks, led by J.P. Morgan & Co Inc.
The company said the $100 million facility replaces a 1994 line of credit, more than doubles its borrowing capacity and significantly reduces its borrowing costs.
The new facility includes a $35 million, four-year amortizing term loan, as well as a $65 million revolving line of credit collateralized with certain company receivables.
Funding under the new facility, said the company, will be used to pay down existing short-term debt, as well as for general corporate purposes.
Orbital is a space and information systems company that makes and sells space and ground infrastructure systems, satellite access products and satellite services.
